subject.title: Generate secretref reference docs from secret target registry metadata

question: Which open SecretRef docs-generation PR should be the canonical implementation path for this issue?
rationale: The issue is still valid, but two overlapping open PRs attempt the same generator/check work and both need maintainer selection before closure.

options.title: Refresh stronger proven sibling
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89142 as the canonical path if maintainers are comfortable adopting it after conflict resolution and fresh proof.

options.title: Repair same-author branch
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/91612 if maintainers prefer the issue author's smaller branch after it resolves conflicts and improves proof/context.

options.title: Request one replacement
options.body: Pause or close both overlapping branches and ask for one narrow replacement PR if neither branch is worth adopting.

recommendation.title: Refresh stronger proven sibling
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89142 as the canonical path if maintainers are comfortable adopting it after conflict resolution and fresh proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent stabilization history on the SecretRef credential matrix docs surface and is the strongest routing owner in the available history.
